packageRules.description: Temurin 21 apk pin: versions come from the Artifactory directory listing; extractVersion filters the hrefs down to temurin-21-jdk-*.apk (jdk and jre release in lockstep, one pin covers both variants)
Automatically merge minor and patch updates for Temurin (quarterly CPU patches; old pins stay installable in the Adoptium index, so a bad automerge is trivially revertible)
Apache Maven tarball pin: majors are excluded — Maven 4 changes the maven-3 download path and is a manual migration
Automatically merge minor and patch updates for Apache Maven (archive.apache.org retains all versions, so a bad automerge is trivially revertible)
